youtube.title: Why Coffee Drops Dry Into Rings ☕ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
When a coffee drop dries, it leaves a dark ring with a pale centre, known as the coffee ring effect. The edge of the drop stays pinned in place while water evaporates fastest there, so liquid flows outward to replace it. That flow carries the tiny coffee particles to the edge, where they pile up and form the ring.
